A01.name: A01_sub_operands_swapped
A01.summary: SUB computes B - A instead of A - B
A01.hides_behind: SUB rX, rX, the idiom for clearing a register
A01.teaches: random operands find it at once; DD104's full sweep counted 65,024 wrong SUBs of 65,536

A02.name: A02_nand_is_nor
A02.summary: NAND computes ~(A | B), which is NOR
A02.hides_behind: NAND rX, rX, the only way to write NOT
A02.teaches: 'I tested NAND' and 'I tested NAND on two different values' are different sentences

A03.name: A03_zero_flag_low_nibble
A03.hides_behind: every check that compares results and not flags
A03.teaches: flags are architectural state; a value-only check cannot see this bug at all
